title: (Push) is an isomorphism for $F/E$ finite
statement:
For finite extensions $E\le F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and every morphism of schemes
$f\colon X\to Y$, the comparison (Push) ([def-sfb-derived-push-hom]) for the coefficient change
$E\to F$ ([def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map]; flat by [lem-sfb-subfield-flat]),

$$
T^Y_{E,F}\circ Rf_*\longrightarrow Rf_*\circ T^X_{E,F},
$$

is an isomorphism of functors on the unbounded derived category $D(\Mod_{E_X})$.

proof.text: Use the same finite E-basis of F and its continuous coordinates as in the flatness proof. The generic scheme_basis_from_point helper produces coherent scalar sections on every scheme and the ordinary scalar-unit copower isomorphism, indexed by ULift (Fin [F:E]). Extension is exact by lem-sfb-subfield-flat.

Apply the generic qbar_isIso_unit lemma in CondensedQbarScalarBasisUnitOfSections to descend the ordinary unit decomposition to arbitrary unbounded derived objects. The scalar-action pushforward identity identifies the derived basis scalars on X and Y. Restriction reflects isomorphisms of modules, and its exact derived functor reflects isomorphisms by the homology criterion.

The mate of derivedPushHom is the inverse restriction/direct-image isomorphism. Apply isIso_iff_unitCoproductComparison with the coherent central basis actions. The remaining comparison is sigmaComparison for the finite index ULift (Fin [F:E]); it is invertible because the derived direct image is additive and therefore preserves finite coproducts. Apply this componentwise and use NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app.
